description_en: Starts a sensitive data identification task in Data Security Guard
description_zh: 调用DsgRunSensIdentify接口启动一个数据保护伞的敏感数据识别任务
name: DsgRunSensIdentify

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. To obtain the tenant ID, perform the following steps: Log on to the [DataWorks console](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console). Find your workspace and go to the DataStudio page. On the DataStudio page, click the logon username in the upper-right corner and click User Info in the Menu section
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID。您可登录[DataWorks控制台](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入数据开发（DataStudio）页面，单击右上方当前登录用户名称，选择菜单 > 用户信息，获取租户ID
parameters.name: tenant_id

element_fields.help_en:
The type of the data source. Valid values:

*   ODPS.ODPS
*   EMR
*   HOLO.POSTGRES
element_fields.help_zh:
数据源类型，取值如下：
- ODPS.ODPS
- EMR
- HOLO.POSTGRES
element_fields.name: db_type

element_fields.help_en: The cluster ID. You can obtain the ID based on the data source you use
element_fields.help_zh: 集群ID。根据您自己的数据源集群获取
element_fields.name: cluster_id

element_fields.help_en: The name of the DataWorks workspace. You can log on to the [DataWorks console](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console) and go to the Workspace page to query the name
element_fields.help_zh: DataWorks工作空间的名称。您可以登录[DataWorks控制台](https://workbench.data.aliyun.com/console)，进入工作空间配置页面获取工作空间名称
element_fields.name: project_name

element_fields.help_en: The username of the operator. We recommend that you enter the username of your Alibaba Cloud account
element_fields.help_zh: 操作者的用户名。建议填写您的阿里云账号名称
element_fields.name: user

element_fields.help_en: The instance ID. You can obtain the ID based on the data source you use
element_fields.help_zh: 实例ID。根据您的数据源获取
element_fields.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The parameters that you need to configure to scan specified metadata
parameters.help_zh: 指定元数据扫描的参数对象列表
parameters.name: es_meta_params
